caption: Performance of different tuning methods on GLUE for RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large. Here we also include two random baselines: (i) S_0-model, where all the designs are randomly selected for RoBERTa. (ii) S_3-model, where we randomly assign strategies to different RoBERTa layers while following the other design choices we learn from T5 models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of various fine-tuning methods on the GLUE benchmark for RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large models. The horizontal axis, labeled “Fine-tuning Method,” presents a sequence of categories in alphabetical order, including Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₂-model, and S₃-model, and the vertical axis, labeled “GLUE Performance,” represents the performance score ranging from 86 to 91. The value axis is linear, starting at 86 and increasing in increments of 2, with tick labels indicating the values 86, 88, 90, and 91. There are six bars, each representing a different fine-tuning method, colored blue for the RoBERTa-base model and orange for the RoBERTa-large model. The bar corresponding to “Prefix” has a height of approximately 86, while the bar for “S₃-model” reaches a height of 91.  The “Adaptor” bar is blue and measures approximately 88, while the “LoRA” bar is blue and measures approximately 87. The “BitFit” bar is orange and measures approximately 87 and the “S₁-model” bar is orange and measures approximately 89.  The "S₂-model" bar is blue and measures about 87, and the "S₃-model" bar is orange and measures approximately 91.
